name: agent-hub
description: Use the Agent Hub v2 local daemon for durable multi-model runs, policy-fenced context egress, encrypted artifacts, and Git handoff in Codex.

interface.longDescription: Agent Hub v2 lets Codex use Claude, Grok, Gemini, and GPT through a 14-tool provider-neutral MCP bridge backed by a long-running local daemon. It validates plans locally, keeps revision-fenced run checkpoints in SQLite, isolates provider workers, encrypts durable artifacts, and preserves portable Git handoffs.
defaultPrompt: Use Agent Hub to prepare an egress manifest and a validated plan for this task, then start the reviewed durable run
Show provider readiness, catalog source, generation verification state, and the routing decision before execution
